mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, leading to a higher probability of Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in more than 55% of cases when HOUST > 1450.0, or the Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which triggers market expectations of a policy response and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC is not significantly positive over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, increasing inflation risks and prompting the Fed to maintain high rates, which suppresses equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 55% of cases where both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the interaction Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 2.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures that delay rate cuts, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.0 and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0, or the interaction Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals a labor market that is both tight and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC is not significantly negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation, signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 60d returns in more than 45% of instances when GDPC1 > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is not significantly positive over any 3-year rolling window.
